Chapter 7143: Run

Chapter 7143: Run

The implosion shocked spectators. Moreover, he burned his true blood so the colossal blood mist erupted in flames.

“Brother!” Apex shouted.

“Senior!” The girl on top of the cosmic ancestral dragon shouted.

“What are you doing?!” Ninth Lady became afraid.

“Everyone, I will watch the rear. I leave this world to you!” Worldbearer declared.

“Elder!” Stone Immortal and Chongming Immortal Monarch couldn’t believe it.

“Activate, Heaven Raiser!” He burned everything and released a blinding light reaching all of Heavenrealm.

The peak primordial immortal’ sacrifice sent everything flying, Kun Peng included. His goal was not destruction but rather, the full activation of his innate gift.

Although he was not a celestial immortal with apex power, the final move wielded incredible power with hints of apex power.

This shattered the Divine Beast Seal, freeing everyone. This seal was created as a contingency plan in case of resistance, not allowing food to escape. It was top secret, even the monarch only speculated its existence.

“Activate the portal!” Worldbearer shouted at the woman and the dragon.

“Senior...” They shouted but this was not the time for hesitation.

“Cosmic Omni-portal!” They worked together, and the dragon formed a galaxy that spread across the Divine Firmament.

Worldbearer’s goal became obvious - sacrificing himself to save everyone else. Although this had a low chance of success for all of Divine Firmament, it could still teleport Worldbearer Firmament away.

“Let’s do this!” Apex, Ninth Lady, and Hao Cai mustered all of their strength to help open the draconic portal.

The best-case scenario was shifting all of Worldbearer Firmament away. Of course, the more evacuees, the better.

“G-go!” Living beings couldn’t reach the cosmic portal, only overlords and immortals.

As for emperors and ancient ancestors, luck played a great role.

“Bring everyone!” Some immortals and overlords summoned transporting treasures to bring their descendants and sects.

At the same time, they also lamented Worldbearer’s heroic sacrifice. The divine beasts have let them down; he was the sole exception, the only one worthy of their respect and love.

“Run now!” Stone Immortal shouted to his followers.

“Your Excellency, you must go now.” He begged the monarch.

“Take them with you, I will die with this world.” The monarch shook his head.

“Go!” Stone Immortal shouted at his followers.

“No one is leaving!” Suddenly, a thunderous voice descended with a might equal to the high heaven.

“Bam!” It crushed Heaven Bearer and destroyed the massive portal. All the primordial immortals fell to the ground.

“No...” The shattered Worldbearer bellowed.
